harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend).

munchkin.description: borg_munchkin_start = TRUE (defaults: depth 16; the entry gate is max clevel < 12, hard-coded)

seed-1045.description: Seed 1045 alone, 100,000 engine turns, fixed birth: the munchkin stair-cycle stall (better-borg-c#204, neo-angband-tracker#403)

experiment.description: Regression fixture for the stall diagnostics: the seed-1045 munchkin stair cycle on milestone 4 (expected: stalled at engine turn 59,893 as a level cycle), with M4 defaults and pristine munchkin as controls that reach the cap.
